acceptance: Every path that ends make pr-arm without arming, including the trunk arm gate refusal, prints one 'pr-arm: outcome: refused: ...' line
A test covers the red-develop refusal and fails without the change
context: Seen 2026-11-01 arming baseline refresh PRs 3914 and 3915 while develop was red from the failed Trunk run on abc110263. The outcome-line behavior was added for hold messages in the pr-arm outcome change; this gate was not routed through it.
description: The earlier change that makes make pr-arm always end with 'pr-arm: outcome: armed|refused|waiting: ...' does not cover the trunk arm gate. When develop is red the refusal text ('Refusing to arm <branch>: develop is red: ...') and 'make: *** [pr-arm] Error 1' are the only output, so a loop that greps for the outcome line sees nothing and logs an empty status.
